players.name: Ollie Gordon II
players.note: If still free, Richard's top RB claim. Week 4: 59% snaps, 11 of 16 RB opportunities, 9-100-1 plus two targets; he took 7 of 8 second-half RB opportunities.

players.name: Braelon Allen
players.note: If still free, claim aggressively. With Breece Hall out, Allen played 94% of snaps and handled every Jets RB opportunity. Hall remains week-to-week.

players.name: Keon Coleman
players.note: Best widely available WR upside. He went 6-116-1 on seven targets; six targets and 105 yards came after DJ Moore aggravated his shoulder. Available in Richard's last diagnostic.

players.name: Keaton Mitchell
players.note: Led the Chargers committee with 38% snaps and 16 of 35 RB opportunities, adding 10 carries and six targets while Hampton fell to 32% snaps.

players.name: Tre' Harris
players.note: 93% snaps, 83% routes, 39% air-yard share and 1.99 season YPRR. Ladd McConkey is week-to-week with a foot injury.

players.name: Alvin Kamara
players.note: The two TDs inflated Week 4, but seven targets, five catches and 35 receiving yards support the half-PPR role. Preferred Saints back over Kendre while Etienne is on IR.

players.name: Dohnte Meyers
players.note: 93% route share and 7-82 on nine targets. Chase is in concussion protocol and Higgins is day-to-day. Great Week 5 Miami spot, then a bye.

players.name: Michael Mayer
players.note: 88% snaps, 69% routes, 10 targets and 8-82 even with Bowers healthy. Legitimate Kincaid hedge/pivot for Richard.

players.name: KC Concepcion
players.note: 100% route share and eight targets in Week 4; 17 targets in two weeks. Pre-Week 4: 30.4% first-read share but 1.01 YPRR. Lower Richard fit because he already rosters Denzel Boston.

players.name: Denzel Boston
players.note: Richard HOLD. Week 4: 95% snaps, 92% routes, seven targets, 65% air-yard share and 4-89. Do not drop for a fringe add.

players.name: Zach Charbonnet
players.note: Richard IR HOLD. Practice window is open, but Seattle ruled him out for Week 5. Team reps this week; Week 6-plus return is plausible.

players.name: Travis Etienne Jr.
players.note: Richard IR hold. Out Weeks 4-7, then a Week 8 bye; earliest possible return is Week 9 on Nov. 8.

players.name: Dalton Kincaid
players.note: Richard downgrade, not a drop. Kincaid has only five targets over two games and his Week 4 route share fell to 49%. Mayer is a legitimate hedge if available.

players.name: Will Shipley
players.note: Conditional stash. Bigsby is headed to IR and Barkley is week-to-week with a hamstring injury; Shipley could get Week 5 volume if Barkley sits.

players.name: Tank Bigsby
players.note: Remove from normal redraft waiver consideration. Headed to IR for core-muscle surgery with an expected absence around six weeks.

players.name: Tyquan Thornton
players.note: Do not chase the 5-111-2 Week 4 line. Dislocated ankle with a 12-16 week recovery timeline.
